name: projeto-menu-restaurante
description: Sistema completo de restaurante responsivo com React, Node, Socket.io e SQLite

scripts.setup-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: npm run setup-all && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
